# Security policy

This is a static, read-only website (GitHub Pages) plus a daily GitHub Actions job.
It has no accounts, cookies, forms, or server. The audit record and the design
decisions are in [`docs/security.md`](../docs/security.md).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Open a GitHub issue that says **only** that you found a security problem and which
page or file it affects. Leave out exploit details. The maintainer will reply there
with a private way to share them.

## Removing your network from the map

That is a privacy request, not a vulnerability. See the privacy policy on the site
(add `_nomap` to your SSID) or open an issue with the network's BSSID.
